title: Sales & Customer Performance
takeaway: Two connected dashboards let a reviewer investigate a product, period or customer segment.
next_step: Investigate high-sales, low-profit segments, then reconcile the underlying transactions.

title: Human Resources Dashboard
takeaway: 8,950 synthetic records reconcile to 7,984 active and 966 terminated employees.
next_step: Compare departments using a consistent as-of date; historical termination share is not a period attrition rate.

title: Advanced SQL Analytics
decision: Distinguish sales value from unit volume.
takeaway: Bikes lead sales value while accessories lead units in the supplied snapshot.
next_step: Check product costs and stock availability before changing pricing or assortment.

title: Sales EDA with SQL
takeaway: 60,398 sales rows represent 27,659 orders; row counts and order counts answer different questions.
next_step: Use distinct orders for order KPIs and investigate missing dates before comparing periods.

title: A SQL foundation for sales reporting
takeaway: Six CRM/ERP files are organized into Bronze, Silver and Gold layers with inspectable transformations.
next_step: Validate joins and metric definitions in SQL Server before connecting a business dashboard.

title: Customer segments worth testing
decision: Choose a segment for a campaign test.
takeaway: Higher-spend, recent profiles show 30.30% observed response versus 15.39% overall in the simulated sample.
next_step: Run a controlled test and measure incremental revenue and campaign costs before reallocating budget.

title: Movie patterns, with the right context
decision: Compare movie groups on a defensible basis.
takeaway: Multi-genre films overlap across groups; financial comparisons use a different subset from the original plots.
next_step: Report sample sizes and positive-budget/revenue coverage before comparing genres; revenue is not profit.

title: E-commerce Sales & Logistics
decision: Identify sales and delivery patterns to investigate.
takeaway: The editable Excel dashboard and recorded walkthrough demonstrate channel and delivery exploration.
next_step: Agree delivery targets and reconcile workbook measures before prioritizing an operational change.

title: Global Data Jobs Market
decision: Understand historical role and skill patterns.
takeaway: Two workbooks explore salaries and skills in 2023 postings; this is not a current market tracker.
next_step: Refresh the source and compare equivalent roles and locations before a hiring or career decision.
